values.subject: ADU-26-0803 utility, ceiling height and daylight memo
values.body_text: Design coordination memo for ADU-26-0803: existing clear ceiling height is 2.34m after the proposed insulated ceiling; retain the east daylight window and document net glazing/operable area; route the bathroom exhaust through a dedicated exterior outlet; the kitchenette sink may connect to the verified west utility wall only after capacity confirmation; the west sleeping-area egress opening must show clear width, height and area on the permit set.
